title: 7.13 Sports and Music
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Talk about sports and music: El tenis es un deporte. Ellos cantan.
grammar_function: Es un/una + noun; jugar tenis/fútbol; cantar una canción.
speaking_outcome: Talk about sports and music: El tenis es un deporte. Ellos cantan.
